material_type: Frozen cell pellets were processed using the streamlined TMT labeling protocol.
sample_source: To address this difficulty, we measured protein and phosphorylation site changes across 11 points of a time course and developed a method for categorizing phosphorylation site behavior relative to protein level changes using the diauxic shift in yeast as a model and TMT11 sample multiplexing.
species: These data also provide a valuable resource for the study of fermentative versus respiratory growth and set a new benchmark for temporal quantitative proteomics and phosphoproteomics for the diauxic shift in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
strain: Yeast strain BY4742 was cultured in synthetic complete media supplemented with 20 g/L glucose and grown at 30 °C with shaking at 250 rpm.
